description: This Java class defines an integration test for the Fineract platform, specifically testing progressive loan disbursement after the loan's original maturity date. It creates a client, configures a loan with multiple disbursements and refunds, performs disbursements and refunds on specific dates, and verifies the loan status and outstanding amounts at each step.

classes.name: ProgressiveLoanDisbursementAfterMaturityTest
classes.description: An integration test class for testing progressive loan disbursal logic after the loan's maturity date in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: testSecondDisbursementAfterOriginalMaturityDate
methods.description: Main test method that simulates the creation of a loan, multiple disbursements, refunds, and the final disbursement after the original maturity date, verifying the proper handling of such scenarios.
